item.title: WillJini raises first round at $3.5M valuation, without pitching a single VC
item.description:
WillJini raises first round at $3.5M valuation, without pitching a single VC
Estate-planning startup WillJini grew from Rs 3 lakh to Rs 50 lakh in monthly revenue over three years using client money, before raising from SPJIMR batchmates, friends, and its own channel partners.

item.title: The Pant Project bags Rs 109 Cr to accelerate retail expansion
item.description: The Pant Project is targeting a larger role in premium menswear after raising Rs 109 crore to expand retail outlets and develop new product categories.

item.title: Amansa Investments, SBI Mutual Fund, others invest Rs 413 Cr in Tonbo Imaging ahead of IPO
item.description: Amansa Investments, SBI Mutual Fund and HDFC Life Insurance Company, among others, have invested over Rs 413 crore in defence electronics maker Tonbo Imaging India Ltd through secondary share transactions, valuing the company at around Rs 4,000 crore.

item.title: IIFL Finance to raise Rs 6,414 Cr led by Blackstone
item.description: Promoters to put in Rs 1,264 crore through warrants; capital adequacy to rise to about 30%

item.title: Bakingo parent raises nearly Rs 100 Cr from Faering Capital
item.description: The company allotted 7,436 Series B compulsory convertible preference shares to the investors after receiving the subscription money, with the allotment approved by its board on July 30, 2026.

item.title: NABARD-backed NABVENTURES raises Rs 450 Cr for second fund
item.description: NABARD’s venture capital arm has announced the first close of its second fund to back early- and growth-stage rural and agritech startups despite a broader funding slowdown in the sector.

item.title: Peppermint Robotics bags Rs 100 Cr in pre-Series B funding round
item.description: The startup, which makes autonomous cleaning robots, is backed by pi Ventures and Crane Venture Partners.
